description: Pipeline health daemon. Every 14400s: (1) count unscored servers (mcp_server_registry WHERE trust_score IS NULL) (2) count stale assessments (last_assessed < now()-7d) (3) count servers with no attestation (not in mcp_attestations) (4) count servers with no threat intel checked (5) count zero-signal servers (not in mcp_signal_scores). ws_write each count as pipeline_health event to mesh_events with severity=WARNING if any count >10 else INFO. Log summary. Heartbeat.
